about: The narrator's lines. A wildlife documentary voice that watches the job applicant the way a nature film watches a small animal having a very bad day. The voice is the one saved in Brandon's ElevenLabs account under the name in audio.narratorVoice in config/showcase.json.
status: DRAFT 2, November 25. Brandon approved this voice from samples. He hears every line on the sound board at the review stop and may rewrite any of them. kit/addenda/001-sound-budget-and-narrator.md says what the Builder may change.

direction.inBrandonsWords: Kind of Australian, National Geographic vibe: talking real slow, with a pause every few words. Somebody narrating what the user is doing in a condescending way, but funny, all of it. Never mean or rude just to be mean and rude. Look at the pitiful applicant as it tries to pay its bills, desperately. More than just wildlife.
direction.hisExample: The lion (pause) walks to the den of his friend (pause) and then (pause) pounces on him.
theFiveThingsItDrawsOn: The pitiful creature: the applicant as a species doing what its kind always does.
Money: rent, bills and loans are why it keeps going.
Company speak, quoted flat by someone who stopped believing it.
Made-up field facts, delivered as science.
The narrator's own opinion: he has watched a thousand of these and is a little bored.
direction.whoTheJokeIsOn: The job hunt and the company. The applicant is the one the audience feels for.
direction.notWanted: A first test voice whispered and sounded sincere. He does not want that. Never whispering, never excited, never cruel. Not constant: it speaks at chosen moments and leaves the rest to the picture and the sound.

rules: The mark / is a pause. It is never spoken. Phase 0 finds what makes this voice pause and replaces the mark with it.
Slow. A line is spoken at no more than audio.narratorMaxWordsPerSecond words a second, pauses included.
Condescending and dry, and always funny first. It pities the applicant. It never insults it for the sake of it.
It says 'the applicant' and 'it'. Never 'you'. On the live site the applicant is the visitor, and the narrator talks about them as if they could not hear.
It never laughs and never raises its voice.
It never explains a joke the picture already tells.
Not constant. Most beats have no line. Room is left for the sound effects.
Every word is spoken exactly as written. No word is added.
Each film line has a 'live' entry: what the visitor does on the live site that plays the same line there, once.

marketing.stroll.text: Here we find / the applicant. / Rent is due.
marketing.stroll.live: the careers page first appears and the visitor moves the mouse

marketing.perks.text: It spots unlimited PTO. / Poor thing / believes it.
marketing.perks.live: the cursor first touches a perk card

step1.firstName.text: First name. / Under fire. / Standard onboarding.
step1.firstName.live: the visitor clicks the First name field

step1.firstName.text: Hit. / It keeps typing. / It has bills.
step1.firstName.live: the first bolt hits the cursor

step1.email.text: A valid email. / Rejected. / The system / is working as designed.

step1.tug.text: It fights for the resume. / Two pages. / One of them is true.

step2.dial.text: A rotary phone. / The applicant / has never seen one.

step2.crank.text: Volume. / All the way up. / It will regret that.

pinball.seal.text: The skills assessment. / No skills / will be assessed.
pinball.seal.live: the ball closes round the cursor

pinball.lobby.live: the ball rolls onto the red carpet

pinball.coffee.text: It runs on coffee / and fear.

pinball.fired.text: Fired. / Before it was hired. / A new record.
pinball.fired.live: the ball drops into the firehouse

pinball.drain.text: The unemployment office. / It knows the way.

boss.verify.text: Not a robot, / it claims. / We will see.

boss.slabs.text: The submit button fights back. / Even it / does not want this job.
boss.slabs.live: the boss fires its first slab

decision.metrics.text: It will apply again tomorrow. / They always do.

liveOnly.about: Lines the live site can add. They play when the named thing happens. One of the list is chosen in order, never at random. A live line never interrupts another line, and the gap between two lines is at least audio.liveNarratorMinGapSeconds.
idle: The applicant has frozen. / A common defence. / It does not work.
Take your time. / The job is not real.
pinball.flipper: It found the flippers. / Hope / is a powerful thing.
boss.verify: It claims to be human. / Bold.
boss.slow: The button is winning. / The button.
skip: It skips ahead. / Efficient. / Still unemployed.
